1: // Simple Neon Grid Escape game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7: 
8:   // Resize canvas to fill the window
9:   const resize = () => {
10:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
11:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
12:   };
13:   resize();
14:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
15: 
16:   // Ship definition
17:   const ship = {
18:     x: canvas.width / 2,
19:     y: canvas.height / 2,
20:     r: 6,
21:     speed: 4,
22:     color: '#0ff',
23:     dx: 0,
24:     dy: 0,
25:   };
26: 
27:   const keys = {};
28:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
29:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
30: 
31:   const updateShip = () => {
32:     ship.dx = ship.dy = 0;
33:     if (keys.ArrowUp || keys.w) ship.dy = -ship.speed;
34:     if (keys.ArrowDown || keys.s) ship.dy = ship.speed;
35:     if (keys.ArrowLeft || keys.a) ship.dx = -ship.speed;
36:     if (keys.ArrowRight || keys.d) ship.dx = ship.speed;
37:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.r, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.r, ship.x + ship.dx));
38:     ship.y = Math.max(ship.r, Math.min(canvas.height - ship.r, ship.y + ship.dy));
39:   };
40: 
41:   // Obstacle grid
42:   const cols = 12;
43:   const rows = 12;
44:   const blocks = [];
45:   const initBlocks = () => {
46:     const w = canvas.width / cols;
47:     const h = canvas.height / rows;
48:     for (let i = 0; i < cols; i++) {
49:       for (let j = 0; j < rows; j++) {
50:         // Leave a gap around the ship start position
51:         if (Math.abs(i - cols / 2) < 2 && Math.abs(j - rows / 2) < 2) continue;
52:         blocks.push({
53:           x: i * w,
54:           y: j * h,
55:           w: w - 2,
56:           h: h - 2,
57:           // direction toward centre
58:           vx: (canvas.width / 2 - i * w) * 0.001,
59:           vy: (canvas.height / 2 - j * h) * 0.001,
60:           color: '#f0f',
61:         });
62:       }
63:     }
64:   };
65:   initBlocks();
66: 
67:   let score = 0;
68:   let gameOver = false;
69:   const speedIncrease = 0.00005; // per frame
70: 
71:   const rectCircleCollide = (rect, cx, cy, cr) => {
72:     const distX = Math.abs(cx - rect.x - rect.w / 2);
73:     const distY = Math.abs(cy - rect.y - rect.h / 2);
74:     if (distX > rect.w / 2 + cr) return false;
75:     if (distY > rect.h / 2 + cr) return false;
76:     if (distX <= rect.w / 2) return true;
77:     if (distY <= rect.h / 2) return true;
78:     const dx = distX - rect.w / 2;
79:     const dy = distY - rect.h / 2;
80:     return dx * dx + dy * dy <= cr * cr;
81:   };
82: 
83:   const updateBlocks = () => {
84:     for (const b of blocks) {
85:       b.x += b.vx;
86:       b.y += b.vy;
87:       // gradually increase velocity toward centre
88:       const dirX = canvas.width / 2 - b.x;
89:       const dirY = canvas.height / 2 - b.y;
90:       const len = Math.hypot(dirX, dirY) || 1;
91:       b.vx += (dirX / len) * speedIncrease;
92:       b.vy += (dirY / len) * speedIncrease;
93:     }
94:   };
95: 
96:   const draw = () => {
97:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
98:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
99: 
100:     // draw ship
101:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
102:     ctx.beginPath();
103:     ctx.arc(ship.x, ship.y, ship.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
104:     ctx.fill();
105: 
106:     // draw blocks
107:     for (const b of blocks) {
108:       ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
109:       ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
110:     }
111: 
112:     // score display
113:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
114:     ctx.font = '20px monospace';
115:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 20, 30);
116:   };
117: 
118:   const loop = () => {
119:     if (gameOver) return;
120:     updateShip();
121:     updateBlocks();
122:     // collision check
123:     for (const b of blocks) {
124:       if (rectCircleCollide(b, ship.x, ship.y, ship.r)) {
125:         gameOver = true;
126:         break;
127:       }
128:     }
129:     score++;
130:     draw();
131:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
132:   };
133: 
134:   loop();
135: 
136:   // simple game‑over overlay
137:   const showGameOver = () => {
138:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
139:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
140:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
141:     ctx.font = '48px monospace';
142:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
143:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
144:     ctx.font = '24px monospace';
145:     ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 40);
146:   };
147: 
148:   // Hook into requestAnimationFrame to draw overlay once stopped
149:   const originalLoop = loop;
150:   const stopLoop = () => {
151:     gameOver = true;
152:     showGameOver();
153:   };
154:   // Replace loop with detection of finish
155:   const wrapper = () => {
156:     if (!gameOver) {
157:       originalLoop();
158:     } else {
159:       stopLoop();
160:     }
161:   };
162:   // start wrapper instead of original loop
163:   // (the first call already started original loop, replace it by re‑starting)
164:   cancelAnimationFrame(); // no‑op safe call
165:   requestAnimationFrame(wrapper);
166: })();

(End of file - total 166 lines)
